description: Build the Document Map of a datasheet PDF: a deterministic, machine-readable index of WHERE the topics live (pinout, package, mechanical, electrical, timing, thermal, absolute_max, registers, cautions …) and WHAT each page physically looks like (table / prose / vector_drawing / raster_image / blank / honest unknown), including a per-page geometry census (vector paths, ruling lines, raster coverage). No LLM is involved — the same document yields the same map, cached by SHA-256, so repeat calls are served from the cache. USE IT FIRST, before reading any page of a datasheet: read the candidate pages it recommends and pick your tool per page from anatomy.dominant_form. The result is wrapped as { contractVersion, documentRef, review, map }; inside `map` it names `map.document.total_pages` (the physical page count) and, per topic, `map.module_targets[].primary_pages` — so it answers 'how many pages' and points to the pages likely to hold the absolute-max ratings / pinout / package drawing (a primary page can miss, so read the candidates and check the warnings). Do NOT use it to get pin names, dimensions, or ratings — it contains no extracted values (use datasheetvend_extract_pinout for pins). Page numbers are physical 1-based PDF pages, not printed labels. Check review.required and the warnings before trusting a degraded map.

documentPath.description: https:// URL to the datasheet PDF. The remote /api/mcp endpoint accepts ONLY https:// URLs (it downloads them); a local filesystem path works solely in local stdio mode (npm run mcp:serve)..

name: datasheetvend_extract_document_map

cached.description: True when served from the deterministic SHA-256 cache

documentRef.description: Echo of the documentPath/URL that was mapped

map.description: The versioned Document Map agent delivery envelope (document_map_agent_v1): document.{total_pages,sha256}, module_targets[], toc[], page_grid_summary, warnings. The top-level envelope also carries `cached` (true on a repeat call for the same document).

title: Map a datasheet (deterministic index)
